statement: Switch visibility, lock, mute or expansion state in file and library handling with "Automatically Pack Resources"; the changed state is visible in the UI and the output, it is saved with the document, and one undo step restores it.

Create new content in file and library handling with "Add Bookmark"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Remove or clear content in file and library handling with "Cleanup Bookmarks"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Remove or clear content in file and library handling with "Delete Bookmark"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Reposition or reshape the current selection in file and library handling with "Move Bookmark"; the resulting positions or shapes match Blender 5.3 for the same input, only the selected items change, and one undo step restores them.
Run the action "Cancel File Operation" in file and library handling; the document or playback state ends as Blender 5.3 leaves it for the same input, and the user can cancel or undo it.

Remove or clear content in file and library handling with "Delete Selected Files"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.
